feeds.title: Marcie in Mommyland
feeds.description: Welcome to Marcie in Mommyland. I started this blog because people are always telling me I'm so 'brave' for traveling with a baby or toddler and they want to know how I do it. The purpose of this blog is to share some of the tips and tricks that we've learned on our adventures so that you can set yourself up for success!

feeds.title: Gal Pal
feeds.description: Dive into a world of inspiration with Lisa Marinkovich, your go-to lifestyle expert! Uncover the latest trends in home decorating, design, wellness, family, travel, and fashion on her captivating blog. Lisa, the proud owner of Galpalgoods.com, has curated a unique store just for women. As seen on Q13 in Seattle and featured in the Seattle Times and PNW Magazine, Lisa brings her expertise to life. Join the vibrant Gal Pal community and explore more for a lifestyle that's as fabulous as you are! Click here for a dose of inspiration.

feeds.title: An Emerald City Life
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Terumi Pong, and I'm a Seattle blogger and mom of twin boys. I love finding new stories about the places I live in and the places we visit and the products we try out and buy and I post my finds frequently.

feeds.title: Mama's Losin' It!
feeds.description: Blog articles focus on parenting, motherhood, financial deals, travel, lifestyle, and more. Kat is a sarcastic mother of three with a busy home daycare.

feeds.title: Clarendon Moms
feeds.description: Clarendon Moms offers original content written by moms, for moms. A comprehensive resource, Clarendon Moms features smart practical tips and advice on pregnancy, parenting, family, cooking, career, health, wellness, beauty, books, entertainment with a focus on fashion, local events, and other fun stuff.

feeds.title: I Am Style-ish
feeds.description: Hi there! I'm Tiffany and I live in Seattle with my husband and our two girls. As a small business owner and mom, I hope to inspire you here with my everyday fashion finds, how to decorate your home and how to live your best life as a busy mom!

feeds.title: Honest Chatter
feeds.description: Honest Chatter is for encouragement faith hope and inspiration for women to engage, share their stories of hope and restoration, in an effort to uplift and inspire others to know they are not alone. Real Talk, Honest Hearts, Inspiring Hope through parenthood, fashion, travel, and self care.

feeds.title: Jenny On the Spot
feeds.description: Jenny On the Spot is a lifestyle and humor-centered storytelling blog, with some crafts and recipes tossed in for your pinning pleasure.

feeds.title: Passion Purpose Passport Blog
feeds.description: Uplifting & Unapologetic Life Coaching & Lifestyle Travel Blog. Kusum is the author behind the blog and a mom herself.

feeds.title: Girlfriend Getaway Guide
feeds.description: Girlfriend Getaway Guide is an award-winning travel blog inspiring women to travel together, featuring travel guides, packing lists, and curated tours.
